method.frozen_state_oracle: exact old full selection/edge decoder; no _observe; same DB state
method.limitations: Synthetic in-memory SQLite and new temporary disk scratch (not real service history), no service/model/Discord; finite curves do not prove arbitrary-size <5s.
method.sql_work_measure: SQLite progress callback every 100 VM instructions during actual local-cap path; includes instrumentation overhead; callback count is a coarse work measure
method.timed: runtime_local_cap = retrieve + CanonicalSnapshot + ScratchLog.write_snapshot memory_observation (flush/fsync) + freeze_retrieval; read_freeze excludes that scratch write for comparison with old harness
method.untimed: ingestion, database backup/startup, scratch startup, old oracle
